projection_inputs.formula: exit block = kappa psi t_exit; settled block = kappa psi t_300 (t_300 = mean pilot child wall to K = 300); the design count formula per block, kappa and psi as measured

ceiling.rule: before each block: carried hours (a continuation's predecessors' measured hours, frozen; 0 otherwise) + cumulative measured hours (completed launch walls + interrupted launch walls) + projected wall of the next block (max(frozen projection at its depth, largest measured wall of a completed launch at that depth)) <= ceiling_h; otherwise exit 6 with an hours summary

policy.classification: P.classify_exit with e_floor = e_EV (worse dF >= R + e; confirm_candidate dF <= -R + e; else unresolved; e = max(e_EV, bar sum))

derived_from_existing_data.note: numbers derived from committed records before the phase; they inform the predictions, they are not predictions themselves
derived_from_existing_data.projection_note: spec v2 (change 9): under exit-then-confirm every confirmation is one launch at the settled projection (3.094 h), and the FINAL COMPLETE POLL confirms every confirm-candidate of N(final incumbent) (46 uncached neighbours of the staged plan) before it completes: q = 0, 1/4, 1/2 of them -> 0, 12, 23 confirmations; in the high case each move also confirms max(2, that count). v1 counted 0 for the final poll. Settled-direct is unchanged.

predictions_recorded_before_run.objective_convention: F = I(x) + gross_operational_cost - TV credit, EUR of total discounted planning cost (cost-breakdown schema v2); gross settlement-excluded; dF_exit = F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0), x0 read as the exit view of the pilot x0_i1 record

Q1.basis: the pilot reference unit (n7 2025 0.25/1, the most expensive screen plan, I = 317,957 EUR): unit_i1 - x0_i1 dF_exit = -20,933 EUR; over the 9 initialisation pairs dF_exit -12,395 to -26,611 EUR, settled -21.9 to -22.2 kEUR (P5_15_S56_PILOT_REPORT.md section 5). Only this one screen plan has been evaluated; the other 17 are untested node-years and durations.
Q1.evaluated_as: phase_results.json report.marginal_value_table.rows with source == "screen" (18 rows, the reference unit's row served from its pilot exit view): status == "certified" and dF_exit < 0 on all 18 (an uncertified screen row counts as not holding: it has no F_exit). prediction_inputs.Q1 carries the counts. RECORDED, NOT PREDICTED: the number of screen rows with dF_exit < -R (R = 10,000 EUR) = prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_dF_exit_below_minus_R
Q1.on_failure: recorded with the failing plans named; NON-STOPPING (Planner decision R1, TASKS 5a, 2026-11-24): no phase decision reads its sign -- the screen, the ladder, the table, the efficiency rule, the candidates and the pool read the exit class against x0 and settled values, never sign(dF_exit) -- and its threshold (dF_exit < 0) lies inside the e_EV band (|dF_exit| <= e_EV = 17,494 EUR), i.e. inside the exit resolution, so a failure is not a determinate sign result. It is therefore not a "failed sign prediction" in the sense of CLAUDE.md's stopping conditions; the phase continues and the outcome is reported at the end.
Q1.statement: every screen plan (a single 0.25 MVA unit: 3 nodes x 3 years x 2 durations = 18) has F_exit below x0's F_exit at 2x -- RECORDED, NON-STOPPING (Planner decision R1)

Q2.basis: pilot 7/7 runs to 300 cycles with 0 local-solve failures and exit 0; step 4 main 4,974 solves, 0 failures; gate F 10/10 children exit 0
Q2.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q2: harness_error_summaries == 0 (every summary the phase read, cache included) and local_solve_failures_total == 0 (sum of evaluation_record.local_solve_failures over every evaluation the phase launched)
Q2.on_failure: a harness_error already stops the phase for review (exit 5, by construction); a local-solve failure is recorded with the run named (the run is then not certified / not settled and is listed as such, never "worse")
Q2.statement: 0 harness_error and 0 local-solve failures over the phase

Q3.basis: the pool holds the pilot settled records x0_i1 F(300) = 812,007,610.45, unit_i1 811,985,758.84, staged_i1 811,973,592.57 EUR (all settled, all gates pass); x0 is the highest by 21.9 / 34.0 kEUR, so Q3 fails only if neither the unit, the staged plan nor a confirmed candidate is eligible (settled, gate-passing)
Q3.on_failure: recorded; the search then starts from x0 (the rule as frozen)
Q3.statement: the best start is not x0

Q4.basis: PROJECTED (spec projected_hours; per block exit 1.292 h, settled 3.094 h; every confirmation one launch at 3.094 h). EXIT-THEN-CONFIRM (the branch when <= 1/2 of the screen + ladder rows are not worse, P1), with q = the confirm-candidate share of the final complete poll's 46 uncached neighbours: no move 32.8 h (q 0) / 69.9 h (q 1/4, 12 confirmations) / 104.0 h (q 1/2, 23); 3 moves, improvers in the first block, 46.0 / 83.1 / 117.1 h; 6 moves, improvers last, 147.5 / 370.2 / 608.4 h (ceiling). SETTLED-DIRECT (> 1/2 not worse): no move 65.2 h, 3 moves 74.5 h, 6 moves late 250.9 h (ceiling). Break-even: one complete poll of the staged plan (10 blocks) costs the same in both branches at 5.8 confirmations. v1's basis (32.8-46.0 / 65.2-74.5 h) omitted the final poll's confirmations (change 9).
Q4.evaluated_as: the author's loop ends with exit 0 (phase_results.json report.termination.reason == "phase_complete") and phase_results.json hours.cumulative_h <= 120
Q4.on_failure: a ceiling stop (exit 6) is recorded with its hours summary and goes to the author (his decision); a review stop (exit 5) goes to the Planner with its reason
Q4.statement: the search terminates (exit 0) inside the 120 h ceiling

Q5.basis: pilot peak 2.77-2.86 GiB over 300 cycles (staged plan 2.85, unit 2.81-2.86); 3.29 = 2.86 x 1.15 (Planner decision). Search plans may carry more cohorts than any pilot plan
Q5.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q5.peak_child_rss_gib = max over every evaluation the phase launched of evaluation_record.peak_rss.child_python_process_ru_maxrss / 2^30 <= 3.29
Q5.on_failure: recorded with the run named; the per-slot memory figure is re-derived before any further phase

Q6.basis: author-approved efficiency rule with the measure of Planner decision P1 (TASKS 5a, 2026-11-24): > 1/2 of the screen and ladder rows NOT classed worse against x0 (confirm_candidate + unresolved: the rows the exit value cannot resolve) -> settled-direct; the v1 measure (+- e_EV band) recorded beside it, information only
Q6.evaluated_as: phase_results.json report.efficiency holds n_not_worse, n_rows, class_counts (per exit class), the exact fraction, the branch taken, the rule, and band_measure_information_only (the v1 band fraction and the branch it would have given) (prediction_inputs.Q6)
Q6.on_failure: a missing record is a harness defect: stop for the Planner
Q6.statement: the efficiency fraction is recorded (no direction predicted)

Q7.basis: the exit values of x0, the reference unit and the pilot staged plan are exit views of stop-disabled, pricing-capture settled runs (v1 report Blocked 2); the screen plans' exit values are exit runs (stop enabled, no pricing capture). Comparing them assumes the two run types reproduce the same trajectory up to the certification cycle. Evidence: cycles 1-2 bitwise in the integration real check (TASKS 2b) only; no EV exit-depth run at 2x exists (v1 report, Not confirmed). Each candidate has both runs, so the phase checks it on every candidate.
Q7.evaluated_as: AUTOMATIC: P.exit_view_check in phase_step at candidate_confirmation (fields read_cycle, F, bar; float.hex identity). phase_results.json report.candidates[i].exit_view_check (equal, differing, exit_run, exit_view, mode) and prediction_inputs.Q7 (n_checked, n_equal, termination_reason)
Q7.on_failure: the phase stops with exit 5, reason "exit_view_mismatch" (mode stop; a first-in-order harness_error stop precedes it, it precedes the offset stop). FALLBACK (TASKS 5a, R4): exit-depth runs of x0, the reference unit and the staged plan (about 1-2 h) and zero-solve reclassification -- built as a continuation spec (v3, --continuation-of this root, --no-pilot-exit-views: x0, the unit and the staged plan then get exit-depth runs and the check is recorded, not stopping); its freeze is a Planner decision
Q7.statement: for each candidate, the exit run's (read_cycle, F, bar) equals, bitwise, the exit_view of the candidate's settled summary (Planner decision R4, held-out check pre-registered)

projected_hours.assumptions:
PROJECTED phase hours (zero solves; the design's count with the frozen per-block projections). Cache at the
    candidate polls = the screen plans + the pool members (ladder plans ignored: unknown before the screen); the two
    candidates are bracketed by the two smallest and the two largest uncached |N| over the screen plans. Search from
    the pilot staged plan (the pool's lowest settled F among the pilot records): low = no move (one complete poll);
    mid = 3 moves, each improver in the first block, 1 confirmation each; high = 6 moves, each improver last.
    Exit-then-confirm: poll blocks at the exit projection; EVERY confirmation is one launch at the settled projection
    (confirmations run one per launch, serially): the candidate-confirmation block, the confirmations of each move
    (mid 1; high max(2, the final-poll count below), since an improver ranked last is preceded by every other
    confirm-candidate of its poll), and the confirmations of the FINAL COMPLETE POLL -- every confirm-candidate of the
    poll at the final incumbent is confirmed before the poll completes -- at a confirm-candidate share q of its
    uncached |N| in PROJECTION_FINAL_POLL_CONFIRM_SHARES (0, 1/4, 1/2; the branch is exit-then-confirm only when at most
    1/2 of the screen + ladder rows are not worse, Planner decision P1), ceil(q |N|) confirmations. v1 counted 0 here
    (spec v2 correction, change 9). Settled-direct: poll blocks at the settled projection, no confirmation step.
    -> dict (hours, counts, assumptions; break-even confirmations per complete poll).
